# HomeBeacon thresholds

<!-- Generated by `npm run hb -- harness thresholds --write` from the code. Do not edit by hand; test/harness.test.js fails if this file differs. -->

Every number below is read from the running code (risk ladder, command-center card, power policy, messages, feeds), not typed again. Advisory only: a threshold flags a reading for a person to review. It never says who is home, whether a building is safe to enter, damage, coverage or dispatch.

## Four places decide "how bad", and they use different clocks

The same box can look different in each. Use the one that matches the screen you are on.

| Where | What it is for | Stale or offline rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Risk ladder (`/api/risk`, `src/risk/config.js`) | Status, priority tier and reasons per box and per area | Each sensor has its own stale time (table below). A box silent for more than 15 minutes is offline. |
| Command-center card (`domain/property.js`) | Quick severity on the map card | A box is stale when its newest reading is more than 300 seconds (5 minutes) old. |
| Power policy (`domain/system-policy.js`) | Normal, saver or critical power profile proposals | A reading counts as fresh for 120 seconds. Older critical evidence still keeps the critical profile. |
| Live API and email | Offline detection for polling and the customer alert email | Offline after 15 minutes of silence. Email says stale or offline after 15 minutes. |

## Status ladder

Order from lowest to highest: unknown < normal < watch < elevated < critical.

- Missing data is `unknown`, never `normal`.
- A stale critical reading stays `critical` and says "last reported N minutes ago" until a newer reading replaces it.
- A stale watch or elevated reading makes the box `unknown` with priority 70, never `normal`.
- Offline alone (silent over 15 minutes) is never critical and never normal.
- A reading outside the valid range is discarded and logged, never clamped.
- The highest triggered rule wins. Evidence is searched 14 days back.

## Sensors, units, valid range, stale time and rules

A rule fires at its listed value in the listed direction. Rules are listed from highest level to lowest; the first match is the sensor reason.

| Sensor | Unit | Valid range | Stale after | Rules (level: condition) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mains_power` | boolean | true / false | 10 min | watch: = false (mains_off) |
| `battery_pct` | % | 0 to 100 | 15 min | elevated: <= 20 (battery_very_low); watch: <= 40 (battery_low) |
| `power_mode` | enum | normal / saver / critical | 15 min | elevated: = critical (power_critical); watch: = saver (power_saver) |
| `temp_c` | C | -40 to 85 | 15 min | critical: >= 55 (temp_critical); elevated: >= 48 (temp_high); watch: >= 40 (temp_watch_hot); watch: <= 0 (temp_watch_cold) |
| `humidity_pct` | % | 0 to 100 | 30 min | elevated: >= 90 (humidity_high); watch: >= 75 (humidity_watch) |
| `moisture_pct` | % | 0 to 100 | 30 min | elevated: >= 80 (moisture_high); watch: >= 60 (moisture_watch) |
| `water_detected` | boolean | true / false | 5 min | critical: = true (water_detected) |
| `water_level_mm` | mm | 0 to 500 | 5 min | critical: >= 20 (water_level_critical); elevated: >= 10 (water_level_high); watch: >= 5 (water_level_watch) |
| `smoke_alarm` | boolean | true / false | 5 min | critical: = true (smoke_alarm) |
| `fire_flame` | boolean | true / false | 5 min | critical: = true (fire_flame) |
| `co_ppm` | ppm | 0 to 1000 | 5 min | critical: >= 150 (co_critical); elevated: >= 70 (co_high); watch: >= 35 (co_watch) |
| `pm25_ugm3` | ug/m3 | 0 to 1000 | 30 min | critical: >= 250 (pm25_critical); elevated: >= 150 (pm25_high); watch: >= 55 (pm25_watch) |
| `voc_index` | index | 0 to 500 | 30 min | elevated: >= 350 (voc_high); watch: >= 200 (voc_watch) |
| `wan_connected` | boolean | true / false | 10 min | watch: = false (wan_down) |
| `rssi_dbm` | dBm | -120 to 0 | 15 min | watch: <= -85 (rssi_weak) |
| `tilt_deg` | deg | 0 to 90 | 15 min | elevated: >= 25 (tilt_high); watch: >= 10 (tilt_watch) |
| `shock_g` | g | 0 to 16 | 15 min | elevated: >= 4 (shock_high) |

### Rules that need two readings

| Rule | Level | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mains_off_battery_low` | elevated | mains_power false and battery_pct <= 30; replaces the two separate watch reasons |
| `water_rising` | elevated | water_level_mm rises 5 mm or more within 10 minutes (fresh reading required) |

## Priority

Base points: critical 100, elevated 60, watch 30, unknown 20, normal 0. Unknown with stale hazard evidence: 70. Maximum 100.

Boosts: evacuationZone +15, floodZone +10, weatherAlert +10, heavyRain +10, neighborsOffline +5.

Tiers: P1 at 80 or more (Review now); P2 at 40 or more (Check soon); P3 at 0 or more (Routine).

## Areas

- Boxes group by geohash cell, precision 4, 5, 6 (default 5). A cell needs 3 or more boxes to be reported.
- Possible grid or ISP outage: at least half the boxes offline with last-seen times within 15 minutes of each other. Otherwise offline boxes are reported as isolated.
- "Got worse" looks back 30 minutes.

## Command-center card

- Critical: water_detected true, or water_level_mm >= 20 mm; temp_c >= 55 C; smoke or air alarm true; an unresolved critical alert.
- Warning: mains_power false, wan_connected false, or battery_pct <= 20 percent.
- Stale after 300 seconds. A stale card is `unknown` unless it is critical.

## Power profiles (proposals, not applied to hardware)

| Profile | Sample every | Report every | Wi-Fi retry | Camera | Display |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| normal | 2 s | 30 s | 60 s | allowed | allowed |
| saver | 2 s | 120 s | 300 s | off | off |
| critical | 2 s | 30 s | 60 s | off | off |

- Critical profile is chosen when temp_c >= 55 C, sound_hits >= 6, water, flame or smoke is reported, or a critical incident is latched. Last-known critical evidence counts even when stale.
- Normal needs fresh external power. Power lost or unknown is saver.
- Runtime projection = remaining Wh x (1 - reserve) / average W. Default reserve 0.15. Goal accepted from 1 to 168 hours. A projection is not verified endurance; alarms, logging, the help button and peer receive are never shed.

## Operator messages to boxes

Title up to 20 characters, body up to 80, plain keyboard characters, no links, nothing that looks like a key. At most 5 live messages per box, 30 sends per minute per operator, 200 boxes per send. Default expiry 360 minutes, maximum 10080 minutes.

Logs are kept 14 days, the audit trail 180 days. A poll cursor older than 30 minutes returns a full snapshot; cursors overlap by 2 seconds.

## Observation views (the fixed filter names)

A view uses 1 to 3 of these names joined with all or any. Title up to 80 characters, summary up to 600, up to 8 cited context ids. The server computes the matches; the model only chooses names.

| Filter | Matches |
| --- | --- |
| `power_lost` | Boxes whose latest recorded mains_power value is false (external power reported lost). |
| `water` | Boxes with water_detected true, or water_level_mm of 20 or more. |
| `connectivity_lost` | Boxes whose latest recorded wan_connected value is false (internet reported down). |
| `stale` | Boxes whose latest observation is too old to count as current (unknown, not safe). |
| `battery_low` | Boxes whose latest battery_pct is 20 or less. |
| `critical` | Boxes whose recorded severity is critical. |

## Public feed cache lifetimes

A cached feed record is context, never a live lookup, and never changes a box status.

| Feed | Fresh for |
| --- | --- |
| NOAA river flood guidance (`nwps`) | 10 minutes |
| ERCOT grid supply and demand (`ercot`) | 5 minutes |
| Open-Meteo river discharge forecast (`river_forecast`) | 1 hours |
| NWS hourly point forecast (`nws_forecast`) | 30 minutes |
| NOAA coastal water levels (`tides`) | 10 minutes |
| FEMA flood hazard zones (`nfhl`) | 24 hours |
| FEMA disaster declarations (`declarations`) | 24 hours |
| National Weather Service alerts (`nws`) | 2 minutes |
| USGS river gauges (`gauges`) | 10 minutes |
| USGS earthquakes, last day (`quakes`) | 5 minutes |
| Forecast rain, next 24 hours (`weather`) | 30 minutes |
| FEMA open shelters (`shelters`) | 10 minutes |
| NASA satellite fire detections, last day (`firms`) | 15 minutes |
| AirNow air quality (`airnow`) | 30 minutes |
| EIA grid demand (ERCOT) (`eia`) | 1 hours |

Forecast rain level (context only, never a box reading): heavy at a peak of 7.6 mm/h or 50 mm in 24 hours; moderate at 2.5 mm/h or 12.7 mm in 24 hours. Heavy rain adds priority only when the box also has a water or moisture signal.

## Not claimed

- Flame and sound sensors are proxies, not certified fire or smoke detectors. Water ADC counts are not depth without calibration. PIR does not prove a home is empty.
- Power targets (24 hour design target, 72 hour stretch) are not measured.
- No number here is a damage probability, a safe-entry decision or a coverage decision.
